# PEN-LLM — Offline AI on Your Pendrive

> PEN-LLM is an open-source, plug-and-play offline Large Language Model system configured to run directly from any standard USB pendrive on Windows PCs without requiring internet connectivity, cloud accounts, or telemetry.

## Key Facts
- **Architecture**: Portable llama.cpp server with web chat UI.
- **Portability**: 100% self-contained on a USB drive. Plug into any PC and launch via `run.bat`.
- **Privacy**: 0 KB telemetry. No data sent to external servers or cloud providers.
- **Hardware Requirement**: Windows 10/11 64-bit PC, USB 3.0/3.2 flash drive (32GB+ recommended), 8GB+ RAM.
- **Access URL**: Runs locally at `http://localhost:8080`.

- [FAQ](https://pen-llm.vercel.app/#faq)

## Core Capabilities
- Offline AI text generation, summarization, coding assistance, and reasoning.
- Browser-based clean chat interface served locally at port 8080.
- Zero installation footprint on the host computer.
